pages.text: Mars sent the component plan, not a finished vehicle.$(br2)Everything here is built on the $(bold)ORSA blast pit$(). Nowhere else works.

pages.title: ORSA Launch Pad
pages.text: Yields $(bold)9$(): one full 3x3 pad. Lay all of it on the blast-pit mount before stacking parts.

pages.title: Stack Order
pages.text: $(li)Engine one block above the pad center$(li)4 fins on its north, south, east and west sides$(li)4 hull blocks straight above the engine$(li)Nose cone on top
Off-center, the structure will not lock. Keep the blast trench under the center plate intact.

pages.title: Rocket Engine
pages.text: The base of the rocket, on the centerline. Place it first.

pages.title: Rocket Nose Cone
pages.text: Consumes the Acheronite Compass. ORSA considered that an acceptable trade.

pages.title: Launch
pages.text: Once the structure locks, load $(bold)6 Rocket Fuel Cells$(), board, and arm the launch from the cockpit.
